recent.text: My @orlandosports recap as the #Magic overpower the Jazz late to go 2-2 on their West Coast trip: “Just in general, the fight, the spirit, (and) the togetherness were exceptional,” Orlando coach Sean Sweeney said. https://t.co/pG68zTipMk

recent.text: #Magic coach Sean Sweeney joked about Franz Wagner only recording one assist at Utah on Wednesday when talking with @Josh_Cohen_NBA about his 38-point performance. Later, Sweeney pointed to Wagner’s leadership throughout the game. “All around, exceptional,” Sweeney said. More: https://t.co/m7bqGofQMq

recent.text: #Magic guard Desmond Bane (25 points) shot 7-for-11 from 3-point range at Utah on Wednesday night. He was 7-for-22 from 3 in two games on this 4-game road trip (missed one game due to an illness). Bane made seven-or-more 3s in a single game just twice last regular season.

recent.text: Desmond Bane beats the halftime buzzer with a three to answer the Ace Bailey turnaround jumper. The #Magic had to search for their offensive formula. But they have found it. Defense has been pretty solid overall. #Magic lead the #Jazz 66-59 at halftime.

recent.text: The real big development that will help determine whether the #Magic win or not while Paolo is out is Anthony Black getting much more confident orchestrating and attacking downhill. He is doing a great job getting into the paint and drawing fouls tonight. ORL 10:13 UTA 6:21 1st

recent.text: This is Orlando’s seventh different starting lineup through the team’s first 11 games. The #Magic will only have 10 players available tonight at Utah on the second night of a road back-to-back.
recent.author: Jason Beede
recent.quoted_text: The #Magic are starting Anthony Black, Desmond Bane, Alex Morales, Franz Wagner and Wendell Carter Jr. at Utah tonight. Morales, a two-way forward, will make his first career NBA start.

recent.text: With Tristan da Silva and Jamal Cain OUT tonight, Alex Morales gets his first career start. This is the #Magic's 7th different starting lineup in their first 11 games.

recent.text: Update: The #Magic say Tristan da Silva (left calf strain) and Jamal Cain (left shoulder contusion) are both OUT for tonight’s game at Utah, the 2nd of a back-to-back. Both were previously listed as Questionable to play.
recent.author: Jason Beede
recent.quoted_text: #Magic coach Sean Sweeney told reporters at Utah that Tristan da Silva (left calf strain) and Jamal Cain (left shoulder contusion) are both progressing and they’ll go through their pre-game shooting slots to see how they feel afterwards. They remain Questionable for now.
